<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''２ひきめ：キャプテンピカチュウ''' ''2nd Monster: Captain Pikachu'') is the second chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters ~The Detouring Volt Tacklers!!~]] manga. It was first published in the October 2023 issue of ''[[Ciao]]'', released on September 1, 2023.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20230903181501/https://www.shogakukan.co.jp/magazines/0613910123 ''Ciao'' October 2023 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kise_ricca/status/1697548323862020603 Ricca Kise on Twitter] (Japanese)</ref> It is eight pages long.
